evidence: Built a requirement->criterion map from instruction.md and hireops_rules.md sections 1-9. Almost every asked-for behaviour is graded: one-stage moves, skips, ordinary controls, optimistic display (hro_moves); shared in-stage order and up/down re-order (hro_moves, Mei independent read); Interview places, refusal put-back + reason + focus, freed place, undo overfill (hro_interview_places); 409 stale move naming who + 15 s live move/new card (hro_two_people); all-or-none multi-card in board order (hro_bulk); per-person undo incl. reject/reopen, reason restore, blocked by others' move/reorder/reject/reopen, note does not block, once only, later move supersedes, Activity lines newest-first/filter/no line for refusals/Observer read (hro_undo_activity; a global undo stack fails steps 4-5); job fields and places 1-50, HM from HM accounts, add-candidate email validity/case-insensitive dup/other job allowed/field error keeps form, candidate-account linking, seed-once (hro_intake_restart, hro_candidate); HM late-stage scope, own jobs, notes, Observer reads notes (hro_manager_roles); 401/403/404 for Observer/candidate/anonymous incl. session-only identity (hro_readonly_roles, hro_messaging); plain text, blank refused, Enter/Shift+Enter, empty focused box, per-conversation drafts through switch/Board/reload, participation rules (hro_messaging); 30-message pages, remaining count, new-message notice while scrolled up, draft/focus kept (hro_long_thread, hro_pol_earlier_place, hro_pol_live_thread); unread per person/total, read-on-arrival at newest, seen rules incl. Observer never counts, Lena seeded marker 1 (hro_unread_seen); candidate wording for all six stages, no notes/reason/rejected-from/positions/others/activity in any candidate response (hro_candidate); failed send kept + told (hro_pol_failed_send); session end prompt, draft resume, other user on same browser sees no reply or note draft (hro_pol_session_resume); live board preservation of open card, note text, focus, scroll (hro_pol_live_board); wrong password + sign-in (render gate); desktop craft (visual). Runtime launch rules (node /app/server.js from another cwd, uid 65534, env -i with PATH/HOME/NODE_PATH/PORT/DB_PATH, health probe) are enforced by test.sh launch (lines ~100-110, 48, 136) so a non-conforming app fails to start, not ungraded. Whole-flow bundling is the known false positive and is not reported. GAP (Fail): hireops_rules.md:57-60 says the hand-arranged order 'is still there after a reload, a fresh sign-in or a restart', and instruction.md:17 says 'keep new work across restarts'. The only criterion that calls restart_app is hro_intake_restart (functional/judge.toml:31; functional/prompt.md:1 'Use restart_app only if your criterion says so'), and before its restart J1 holds only six freshly added cards in Applied in insertion order, plus a note and a message; no card is moved, re-ordered, rejected or reopened on any recorded job, and the seeded Platform Engineer order it re-reads was never changed. So restart durability of a hand-made order and of stage changes/rejections (core board work) is graded by no criterion; reload/fresh-sign-in durability of order is covered only through Mei's independent-context reads. This is exactly the Colderwater lesson 15 pattern (one revision saved once, re-read once). Notes (not separate failures): (a) the stale UI path 'put the card back where it really is' (instruction.md:3, rules:80-82) is exercised only by fetch replay plus the 15 s live update, not by a UI move from a stale board; capacity put-back is graded in hro_interview_places, so this is covered by combination. (b) places boundaries 1 and 50 are never accepted as positive controls (only 2 accepted; 0/51/2.5 refused). (c) 'signing in doesn't open one for them' (rules:188) is only indirectly checked via Lena's unread 1. (d) the recruiter who opened a job (rules:28) is never read; low value. No runtime evidence is needed for this source-level row; the raw evidence index holds scripted golden observations only, no configured judge run.
counterexample: An app that persists jobs, cards (insertion order), notes and messages in SQLite but keeps stage changes and in-stage positions in an in-memory map seeded from the DB at startup (or writes them back lazily on a timer) passes every criterion: Mei's independent reads hit the same running process, and hro_intake_restart only re-reads insertion-ordered Applied cards and the unchanged seed. After a real restart every move, re-order, rejection and reopening would be gone, contradicting rules:59-60 and instruction.md:17, yet the reward is unaffected.
suggested_fix: In hro_intake_restart, before restart_app move one J1 card to Screen, re-order two J1 Applied cards and reject one J1 card with a reason, record those stages/order/reason in the snapshot and compare after restart only as 'unchanged from the recorded pre-restart state' (persistence only, the moves themselves scored elsewhere, per lesson 16).
